status: preregistered after r40 rejected the unpatched images at startup and after matched overlay construction; before any r41 server or request

lineage.r39: MTP0 c64 A/B was isolated and complete but repeated only 56/64 token arrays; candidate was not run.
lineage.r40: Full batch invariance was requested but both original images fail closed because GDN_ATTN does not advertise the capability; no endpoint or request existed.
lineage.r41_change: Apply only the existing conditional GDN capability advertisement to both images. It remains false by default and becomes true only when serial-exact GDN is explicitly enabled.

overlay.scope: one Python backend capability method only; no arithmetic, scheduler, kernel, model, or default behavior change
overlay.smoke: Both images returned supports_batch_invariance false by default and true with VLLM_XPU_GDN_NATIVE_SPEC_RECURRENT_SERIAL_EXACT=1.

fixed_profile: Both arms: local B70 devices 0,1; official FP8 plus W8A16; TP2; c64; p128; max length 256; max sequences 128; max batched tokens 512; FP16 KV; XPU Graph off; deterministic Inductor; global batch invariant on; RMS batch invariant on; serial-exact GDN on; persistent GDN scratch; oneCCL P2P and explicit waits; 0.95 GPU reservation; prefix cache off; temperature 0; ignore_eos true.
ordered_method: Fresh control A first-and-only same-shape batch freezes 64 arrays. Fresh control B must match 64/64 before fresh candidate A/B run against the same oracle. Every attempt uses an empty compile cache and direct-I/O model verification.
correctness_gate: All validation attempts must match 64/64 complete 128-token arrays with cached_tokens=0, no cross-base collision, post-health, bounded cleanup, and no xe reset/fault/OOM. Candidate must match the deterministic MTP0 control exactly.
performance_gate: Candidate A/B median must exceed control A/B median and reach at least 875 aggregate tok/s; 1000 is preferred.
failure_policy: Any mismatch, startup issue, or missing liveness/correctness evidence fails closed. No individual attempt rate is publishable.
reporting_boundary: Direct c64 short-context TP2 measurement only; no extrapolation.
